findings.issue: The packet leaves worker_model null and allocation pending Z assignment, while the review trial identifies gpt-6-luna as the requested reviewer. The build worker identity and assignment are therefore intentionally unresolved; treating the candidate lane as an assignment would bypass the stated Z authority.
findings.suggested_fix: Before dispatch, have Z record the selected build worker/model and assignment in a versioned packet or accompanying authorization; do not infer it from the reviewer trial.

findings.issue: The acceptance criterion requires usage/cost evidence or explicit nulls, but the template starts usage.source as "unavailable until provider receipt is supplied" and does not define a terminal representation distinguishing an unavailable source from measured zero or unresolved data.
findings.suggested_fix: At receipt completion, set source to the observed evidence source or "unavailable" and retain null numeric values; keep cost_coverage unknown when any necessary cost is unknown, as specified in the workflow README.
